name: Yuuki Yuuna wa Yuusha de Aru - Jukai no Kioku
original_name: 結城友奈は勇者である 樹海の記憶
source:
Sanshuu Middle School 2nd year, Yuuki Yuuna.
Cheerful, energetic and always optimistic, she's a normal girl that is a member of the "Hero Club", a club that does anything it can to help people out.
With the 3rd year Inubouzaki Fuu at its center, the Hero Club's activities include all sorts of things that benefit the public, from "finding foster parents for kittens" to "helping out at the kindergarten".
However, the girls of the Hero Club have a true, secret duty:
To fight mankind's natural enemy, the "Vertex", in a different dimension that regular people don't know about, the "Jukai".
Only chosen Heroes have what it takes to fight the enemies that invade the Jukai to bring an end to the human world.
...Or that's how it's supposed to be, but the Jukai seems to be a bit off lately...?
Who is the mysterious figure they encounter within this space where only Heroes and Vertex should be able to move...?

[From [url=https://boards.fireden.net/vg/thread/200886613/#q201275103]/yyy/[/url]]
translation:
三州中学二年级，优纪优奈。
她是一个开朗、充满活力、总是乐观的普通女孩，是“英雄俱乐部”的成员，这个俱乐部竭尽全力帮助人们摆脱困境。
英雄俱乐部以三年级的犬保崎风为中心，开展从“为小猫寻找养父母”到“到幼儿园帮忙”等各种公益活动。
然而，英雄俱乐部的女孩们有一个真正的、秘密的职责：
在普通人不知道的异次元“树海”中，与人类的天敌“顶点”进行战斗。
只有被选中的英雄才有能力对抗入侵树海的敌人，从而终结人类世界。
……本来就是这样的，但是树海最近好像有点不太对劲……？
在这个只有英雄和顶点才能移动的空间里，他们遇到的神秘人物是谁……？

[来自[url=https://boards.fireden.net/vg/thread/200886613/#q201275103]/yyy/[/url]]
